description: FAKE SDK investigation for chaos fixture c15 (hephaisto-chaos/shop-api): finds the crash-looping pod, reads its logs and concludes that startup throws a NullReferenceException in src/Shop.Api/Startup/Endpoints.cs, citing the log line verbatim. Runs through Hephaisto's real investigator endpoint. Then proposes a plan with no cluster action. No model runs.

input.summary: FAKE SDK: shop-api crash-loops because startup throws a NullReferenceException in Shop.Api.Startup.Endpoints.Primary when Shop:Endpoints is absent.

findings.hypothesis: Startup dereferences a null Shop:Endpoints list in Endpoints.Primary, so the process dies before the host starts and the pod crash-loops.

code_refs.note: options.Endpoints.Count is read without a null check

input.summary: FAKE SDK: a null dereference at startup is a code bug; nothing in the cluster would fix it.
